title: God Renews the Promise to Abram

reflections.title: God's Generous Gift to Abram

reflect.text: Abram had just stepped back and let his nephew Lot choose the best land in order to keep family peace. Lot grabbed what looked fertile and pleasant, but Abram chose to avoid strife. As Charles Spurgeon noted, God "delights to manifest His grace to those who seek peace." God takes notice whenever we put peace ahead of our own advantage.

Right after Lot departed, God told Abram to look north, south, east, and west. The Lord promised all of this land to Abram and his offspring forever, telling him to walk across it in faith before he even possessed it. Abram had willingly surrendered a small valley, but God gave him the entire country. We never truly lose out when we obey God and let go of selfish gain.

Abram responded by pitching his tent and building an altar to worship the Lord. He did not need to scramble for his share because he rested securely in God's care. When we know God provides for our future, we can hold worldly things loosely, treat others with generosity, and live with thankful hearts.

questions: When is it hard for you to let go of your own preferences to keep peace with others?
How does knowing God's generosity help you hold your earthly possessions loosely?
reflections.prayer: Lord, thank You for being faithful and generous to all Your people. Help us to pursue peace with others, even when it means giving up our own rights. Teach us to trust Your care and worship You with grateful hearts each day. Amen.
